<parameter name="EPGSingleColumnSpecs" value="0,135,5,165,15"/>
		<!-- Native OpenATV/OE-Alliance single EPG + EPGSearch date/time columns.
		     The older 225px date/time rectangle clips localized dates and crowds
		     the optional EPGSearch orbital position. OpenPLi EPGList computes
		     its own geometry and ignores this optional parameter. -->
		<parameter name="EpgListSingle" value="85,310" />

<!-- Explicit EPGSearch layout: search plugin chooses this screen before its
       generic EPGSelection fallback on OpenATV. Independent columns keep the
       native datetime and optional orbital-position fields clear of titles. -->
